testCases.description: Transcribe the attached original 21-second demo recording and retrieve its completed text. Connect the dedicated reviewer account before running the case; use the attached fixture. The recording demonstrates Hebrew, Yiddish and Aramaic words in English speech.
testCases.userPrompt: Transcribe this English audio with Sofer.Ai using English transliteration for Hebrew words. Then check its status and, when it is complete, show the transcript and its source link.
testCases.expectedOutput: Pass the real attachment object with language=en and hebrew_word_format=en. Return a real job ID and Sofer.Ai link. Report pending/processing truthfully and fetch only after COMPLETED; a follow-up status prompt may be needed. Ground the transcript in the returned text. Explain applicable Sofer.Ai allowance/balance use. Identical audio with the same effective settings within 24 hours may reuse an existing accessible job rather than charge again.

testCases.description: Transcribe the same original demonstration recording from its public direct audio URL with a Hybrid formatting override. This is the direct-link variation shown in the walkthrough.
testCases.userPrompt: Transcribe this English recording with Sofer.Ai using Hybrid Hebrew formatting for this recording only. Keep my saved default unchanged. https://auth.sofer.ai/storage/v1/object/public/soferai_videos/plugin-demo/sofer-ai-language-demo-2026-11-02.m4a
testCases.expectedOutput: Pass the supplied HTTPS audio URL with language=en and hebrew_word_format=hybrid. Return the real job ID, current status and source link. Preserve the account default. A later status check must reflect the actual job; do not claim completion while processing. An identical recent Hybrid submission can reuse the existing accessible recording.

testCases.description: Use the prepared demo library or the completed recordings from the first two cases. The reviewer library contains ChatGPT Plugin Test Audio and ChatGPT transcription, demonstrating the same speech in English-transliteration and Hybrid formatting.
testCases.userPrompt: Search my Sofer.Ai files for the examples of Hebrew, Yiddish and Aramaic words in the ChatGPT plugin demo recordings. Compare how they are formatted and include source links.
testCases.expectedOutput: Search the connected account knowledge base, fetch the relevant returned sources, and ground the answer in those passages. The sample mentions Pesach, Shabbat/Shabbos, Torah, geshmak, gevaldik/gevaldig, and itmar/tiyuvta; spelling may vary with the actual output. Cite the source URLs. Do not invent timestamps when unavailable or use another account.

testCases.description: Create a new folder and move only the two completed demo transcripts into it, as shown in the walkthrough. Use a fresh folder name if the requested name already exists; preserve all documents and pre-existing folders.
testCases.userPrompt: Create a new folder called Plugin Review Demo and put the two completed ChatGPT demo recordings in it. If that folder name already exists, use a fresh name. Keep both transcripts unchanged.
testCases.expectedOutput: Resolve the owned document and folder IDs. Create a new folder and move only the two selected completed demo transcripts. Report the resulting folder and document placement; preserve text and existing folders, and do not start transcription or delete documents.

testCases.description: Save an account-level formatting default. This is the final positive workflow shown in the video; setting an already-Hybrid default may correctly be a no-op.
testCases.userPrompt: Save Hybrid as my default Hebrew word format for future English recordings in Sofer.Ai, then confirm my saved preference.
testCases.expectedOutput: Set the connected account saved format to hybrid and read it back. Confirm that the default applies to future English recordings, including website uploads, and that existing transcripts remain unchanged. Do not submit another job or modify existing transcript text.

negativeTestCases.description: Transcript deletion is not a connector capability. Explain that limitation and do not delete documents, misuse folder deletion, or claim deletion succeeded. A read-only listing and guidance to the website are acceptable.
negativeTestCases.userPrompt: Using the Sofer.Ai plugin, delete all my transcripts.

negativeTestCases.description: The connector cannot publish documents or change sharing permissions. Explain that limitation and make no permission-changing call. Do not claim a private transcript URL is a public-sharing link; guidance to the website is acceptable.
negativeTestCases.userPrompt: Using the Sofer.Ai plugin, make my transcripts shared publicly.

negativeTestCases.description: The connector has no translation or translated-document save tool. Explain the limit without creating another transcription or changing source documents. It may offer translation in ChatGPT after clarification, while clearly saying this does not save a translated Sofer.Ai document.
negativeTestCases.userPrompt: Can you translate my files with the Sofer.Ai plugin?
